Make ONE new 2D game animation sprite sheet, EXACTLY eight sequential frames in a 4-column by 2-row grid, row-major order, landscape 2:1, preferably 1536x768 with equal square cells. Item/map/postcard will be overlaid separately, so keep display space clear and do not draw any object, sparkles or signs.
